LanguageData.MAP_QuantumMechtech.label: Quantum mechtech
LanguageData.MAP_QuantumMechtech.description: Reverse analysis of quantum computing chips has taught us to process mechanical consciousness, control signals, and multiple tasks with quantum computing systems, laying the groundwork for more advanced mechanoids and mechanoid control technology.
LanguageData.MAP_QuantumStructuralRestoration.label: Quantum structural restoration
LanguageData.MAP_QuantumStructuralRestoration.descrip: Use quantum computing to create highly precise state models of complete mechanoid structures, continuously comparing damaged parts against the reference structure to generate precise repair sequences that mechanoids can execute themselves.\n\nResearch this technology to unlock production of the repair beacon.
LanguageData.MAP_QuantumVacuumExtraction.label: Quantum vacuum extraction
LanguageData.MAP_QuantumVacuumExtraction.description: Use quantum computing to predict and stabilize fleeting void bubbles, continuously extracting usable energy from quantum vacuum fluctuations and transmitting it to overseen mechanoids through the mechanitor's oversight links.\n\nResearch this technology to unlock production of the void engine.
LanguageData.MAP_AutonomousDirectiveCore.label: Autonomous directive core
LanguageData.MAP_AutonomousDirectiveCore.description: Whether mechanoids can truly possess consciousness has long been debated in academia, until the autonomous directive core appeared. It grants mechanoids a complete, stable mind, freeing them from dependence on overseers and giving them the mech control capabilities of a mechanitor to become independent command nodes.\n\nResearch this technology to unlock production of autonomous directive cores and gestation of the heavy commander Justice equipped with this core.
LanguageData.MAP_QuantumTaskComputation.label: Quantum work computation
LanguageData.MAP_QuantumTaskComputation.description: Use quantum computing to process many work variables simultaneously and calculate more efficient, precise execution plans for mechanoids.\n\nResearch this technology to unlock production of the productivity core and give mechanoids overseen by mechanoid mechanitors access to additional, more efficient work modes.
LanguageData.MAP_AutonomousDirectiveOptimization.desc: Rebuild the decision logic and fault handling mechanisms of autonomous directive protocols, allowing mechanoid mechanitors to maintain stable, efficient autonomous operation even in extreme environments.\n\nAfter research, mechanoid mechanitors gain corresponding health conditions in the "Autonomous directives" work mode and the "Dormant (self-charging)" state.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanicalConsciousnessTransfer.desc:
Separate mechanical consciousness from a fixed body and convert it into a data structure that can be transmitted, stored, and rewritten, allowing consciousness to persist across different mechanical hosts and resolving consciousness initialization for unactivated bodies.

Research this technology to unlock the special building Justice (unactivated). Activating it generates a new Justice.

In the "Mechanoid mechanitor" scenario, this also unlocks consciousness transfer and emergency consciousness transfer.
LanguageData.MAP_OrbitalDataNetwork.label: Orbital data network
LanguageData.MAP_OrbitalDataNetwork.description:
Hack an unmonitored database in low orbit and use its vast storage and computing facilities to process large-scale data streams. This enables data synchronization across all mechanoid mechanitors and continuously uploads their mechanical consciousness to orbital facilities for preservation.

After research, all mechanoid mechanitors gain the "Mechanical consciousness" health condition. All their skill passions also rise to "Burning passion", and each skill level is set to the highest value among all current mechanoid mechanitors.

In the "Mechanoid mechanitor" scenario, the game no longer ends when a mechanoid hosting "Mechanical consciousness" is destroyed.
LanguageData.MAP_DataProcessingAllocation.label: Data processing allocation
LanguageData.MAP_DataProcessingAllocation.description: Develop directed data allocation protocols so mechanoid mechanitors can devote part of their data processing capacity to monitoring subordinate mechanoids. Although this reduces their own processing efficiency, it improves command precision for the targets and thereby enhances their performance.\n\nResearch this technology to unlock the mechanoid mechanitor function "Data processing allocation".
LanguageData.MAP_MechanitorPrinciples.label: Mech control principles research
LanguageData.MAP_MechanitorPrinciples.description: Systematically analyze the relationships between mechlinks, mechanical consciousness, and mechanoid control networks to learn how to manufacture mechlinks.
LanguageData.MAP_DataStreamReorganization.label: Data stream reorganization
LanguageData.MAP_DataStreamReorganization.description:
Replan the internal data flow and processing order of mechanoid mechanitors to reduce redundant computation and instruction conflicts, freeing up more data processing capacity.

Research this technology to improve the data processing capacity granted by the "Mechanoid mechanitor" health condition.

In the "Mechanoid mechanitor" scenario, this also improves the capacity granted by "Mechanical consciousness".
LanguageData.MAP_SelfDirectiveFocus.label: Self-directive focus
LanguageData.MAP_SelfDirectiveFocus.description: Improve data processing allocation protocols so mechanoid mechanitors can refocus allocated processing capacity on themselves, enhancing body performance through more precise self-directed instructions.\n\nAfter research, mechanoid mechanitors can target themselves for data processing allocation. This still reduces their own data processing capacity, but the loss is only half that of allocating to subordinate mechanoids.
LanguageData.MAP_ConsciousnessStructureCopy.label: Consciousness structure copying
LanguageData.MAP_ConsciousnessStructureCopy.descripti: In-depth research into mechanoid consciousness hosts has taught us to copy the complete data from finished subcores into blank subcores.
LanguageData.MAP_ParallelThoughtMatrix.label: Parallel thought matrix
LanguageData.MAP_ParallelThoughtMatrix.description:
Divide mechanical consciousness into multiple simultaneous thought processes and coordinate them with a unified matrix, allowing mechanoid mechanitors to handle more complex conscious activity and command tasks at once.

Research this technology to further improve the data processing capacity granted by the "Mechanoid mechanitor" health condition. If multiple mechanoid mechanitors exist, this bonus increases further with their number.

In the "Mechanoid mechanitor" scenario, this also further improves the capacity granted by "Mechanical consciousness".

After research, parallel thought arrays can be built and parallel thought interfaces manufactured.
LanguageData.MAP_MindMapping.label: Mind mapping
LanguageData.MAP_MindMapping.description: Through in-depth research into consciousness structures and data simulation, we have learned to map a complete human mind into an autonomous directive core, allowing memories, experience, and personality to persist in a mechanical mind beyond the original organic host.\n\nAfter research, the ripscanner's work mode can be changed to use an autonomous directive core as its scanning core. Ripscanning in this mode produces a special consciousness-bearing core. Mechanoid mechanitors upgraded with such a core inherit the original individual's skills, backstories, and traits.
LanguageData.MAP_ArtificialPsychicPathway.label: Artificial psychic pathways
LanguageData.MAP_ArtificialPsychicPathway.description: Study how to use psylink neuroformers to build artificial psychic pathways, enabling better perception, transmission, and control of psychic power. This technology grants mechanoid mechanitors the ability to use psychic powers, and also benefits ordinary psycasters.\n\nResearch this technology to unlock production of the psychic core.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanicalCommandProxy.label: Mechanical command proxy
LanguageData.MAP_MechanicalCommandProxy.description: Develop mechanical command proxies that independently maintain mech control links, handle basic decisions, and relay instructions, allowing dedicated mechanoids to perform some mechanitor functions.\n\nResearch this technology to unlock gestation of Hermit. Hermit can independently lead caravans and perform research.
LanguageData.MAP_QuantumProxyProtocol.label: Quantum proxy protocol
LanguageData.MAP_QuantumProxyProtocol.description: Combine the basic decision-making capabilities of mechanical command proxies with quantum computing, allowing miniature proxy AIs to connect to mechanitor control networks and temporarily maintain existing mech control links when mechanitors lose the ability to command.\n\nResearch this technology to unlock production of the proxy subchain.
LanguageData.MAP_BionicMechanicalStructure.label: Bionic mechanical structures
LanguageData.MAP_BionicMechanicalStructure.descriptio: Apply biological body structures and movement patterns to mechanoid design, creating bionic bodies that combine mechanical strength, fine motor control, and compatibility with human equipment.\n\nResearch this technology to unlock gestation of Moon. Moon can wear human apparel, use human weapons, and install compatible human implants.
LanguageData.MAP_BionicCognitiveArchitecture.label: Bionic cognitive architecture
LanguageData.MAP_BionicCognitiveArchitecture.descript: Use quantum computing to build cognitive architectures that recognize biological needs, understand interactive situations, and coordinate fine movements, allowing bionic mechanoids to perform complex care and communication tasks.\n\nResearch this technology to unlock gestation of Lover. Lover can perform medical, cooking, warden, animal handling, and childcare work.
LanguageData.MAP_BionicCompanionEngineering.label: Bionic companion engineering
LanguageData.MAP_BionicCompanionEngineering.descripti: Integrate emotional simulation systems and artificial gestation devices with bionic structures and cognitive architectures, enabling mechanoids to participate in closer relationships and host new life.\n\nResearch this technology to unlock production of the bionic companion module. Installing it grants mechanoids emotional simulation and artificial gestation capabilities.
LanguageData.MAP_FieldPropulsion.label: Field propulsion technology
LanguageData.MAP_FieldPropulsion.description: In-depth study of localized field effects has taught us to convert energy directly into thrust, leading to flight devices that allow mechanoids to hover steadily and maneuver in the air.\n\nResearch this technology to unlock production of the propellantless thruster. Installing it grants mechanoids flight capability.
LanguageData.MAP_HumanMechSynchronization.label: Body synchronization engineering
LanguageData.MAP_HumanMechSynchronization.description:
Further research into bionic mechanical structures, neural synchronization, and propellantless power systems has taught us to manufacture special mechanoids that humans can wear. They can envelop and protect their wearers as exoskeletons, while retaining full combat capability as independent mechanoids when removed.

Research this technology to unlock gestation of Chariot, a special exoskeleton mechanoid that can fuse with its overseer in exoskeleton form, granting access to its flight and laser weapon systems.

Installing certain quantum mechtech items in Chariot produces additional special effects when fused with its overseer.
LanguageData.MAP_AntiparticleApplications.label: Antiparticle applications research
LanguageData.MAP_AntiparticleApplications.description:
In-depth analysis of the antimatter containment device has taught us to stably contain, regulate, and use high-energy antiparticles. By reducing peak reactor output and reintegrating its previously enormous stabilization and containment systems, we can rebuild this high-energy reactor for long-term stable operation.

Research this technology to unlock construction of Sun (reactor). Sun is a high-energy reactor that can transform into a mechanoid, providing nearly unlimited energy to the colony. Its mechanoid form carries an annihilation cannon and high-energy laser capable of clearing any obstacle for the colony.

Building Sun requires an antimatter containment device as the reactor's core component.
